title: Museum of Models collection
description:
Every answer every model gave to the same questions, kept after the models are gone.

18,467 answers from 381 models to 100 questions, asked between 2024-05-23 and 2026-10-23. 103 of the models are retired: OpenRouter no longer serves them. Drawings as SVG, websites as HTML with screenshots, images, writing, code and audio, each kept as it was given. The collection behind museumofmodels.com.
